nodes.description: Internal balance mapping of the ERC20 token, mutated by _mint, _transfer and _burn.
Nested allowance mapping controlling spenders, written by _approve and read in transferFrom.
Total token supply, increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
Fixed token supply of MyToken set to 1000000000 * 10**18, used as the mint amount.
MyToken constructor that names the token SEJONG/SJC and mints INITIAL_SUPPLY to msg.sender.
Internal mint routine that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Internal transfer routine that debits and credits balances and emits Transfer.
Public ERC20 transfer entrypoint using _msgSender() as the sender.
Public allowance-based transfer entrypoint reading and reducing allowances.
Virtual empty hook invoked before every mint, burn and transfer, a potential reentrancy/callback point.
Caller-controlled address, used as mint recipient and as the sender in transfer/approve paths.
_totalSupply += amount supply mutation inside _mint, arithmetic-sensitive state update.
_balances[account] += amount balance credit inside _mint, arithmetic-sensitive state update.
Amount of tokens to mint, a parameter of _mint driving supply and balance arithmetic.
Token name string parameter of the MyToken constructor.
Token symbol string parameter of the MyToken constructor.
Local copy of _balances[sender] cached before the debit in _transfer.
Local copy of the spender allowance read and reduced in transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside the MyToken constructor deployment context.
msg.sender is passed as the account argument to _mint, granting the deployer caller the full INITIAL_SUPPLY.
transfer uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the source of the token movement.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the allowance spender for the movement.
The account parameter of _mint is the credited address of the balance update.
The amount parameter of _mint drives the total supply and balance additions.
The MyToken constructor transfers control to _mint to create the initial supply.
INITIAL_SUPPLY is read within the constructor to define the mint amount.
INITIAL_SUPPLY is supplied as the amount argument of the _mint call.
_mint performs the _totalSupply += amount arithmetic state update.
_mint performs the _balances[account] += amount arithmetic state update.
_mint invokes the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating supply and balances.
_transfer invokes the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balance mutation, a potential reentrant callback.
The name_ constructor parameter is stored into the _name state variable.
The symbol_ constructor parameter is stored into the _symbol state variable.
senderBalance local is derived from _balances within _transfer and validates the debit.
currentAllowance local is derived from _allowances within transferFrom and validates the transfer.
transfer forwards execution to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom forwards execution to the internal _transfer routine after allowance checks.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter only exists as the credited address of the _mint operation and has no independent semantic role.
The amount parameter flows directly into the balance credit arithmetic inside _mint.
The name_ parameter is only consumed by the constructor to initialize the token name.
The symbol_ parameter is only consumed by the constructor to initialize the token symbol.
senderBalance is a transient cache of the balance mapping used only within _transfer.
currentAllowance is a transient cache of the allowance mapping used only within transferFrom.
